spanish: Y madrugaron desde el día siguiente, y subieron holocaustos, y acercaron pazes, y se sentó el pueblo a comer y a beber, y se levantaron a jugar.

findings.issue: H8002 is the plural peace-offering noun; pazes only says peaces and drops the offering.
The second a is an unmarked purpose preposition; the token is waw plus a qal infinitive absolute.

notes: Person, number, and the other stems match the tokens.
